title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
summary: Needle2 is a 14MB agentic LLM optimized for edge devices like phones, wearables, and robots, achieving 500 tokens/sec on Raspberry Pi 5. It uses 2-bit compression and Simple Attention Networks, outperforming larger models on tool-call benchmarks. It supports structured extraction, fine-tuning, and hybrid cloud escalation, targeting the vast low-cost IoT market.
